This site hosts a static [Quarto dashboard](https://quarto.org/docs/dashboards/) for exploring Everglades National Park buoy salinity data from [SECOORA ERDDAP](https://erddap.secoora.org/erddap/index.html).

The dashboard reuses interpolation and mapping methods from the [south-florida-salinity](https://github.com/usf-imars/south-florida-salinity) project:

- **Leaflet** htmlwidgets for interactive buoy maps ([Quarto htmlwidgets](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/widgets/htmlwidgets.html))
- **DIVAnd** variational analysis with bathymetry-aware land masking
- Hourly field panels at 06:00, 12:00, 18:00, and 24:00 US Eastern

## Open the dashboard

[**Launch dashboard →**](dashboard.html)

## Build locally

```bash
quarto render
```

To publish as a static site on GitHub Pages:

```bash
make publish
```
